notes.title: Mission Z - Survival game
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1401750/extras/Main2.png?t=1601526492[/img]

We are developing our new game called [b]Mission Z[/b], an open world game, with story mode, where you can do quests, buy items, customize weapons, find items on the map, find collectibles and survive!

For those who like open world games with history, it is very worth checking out!

[b]See Mission Z on Steam:[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1401750/Mission_Z/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1401750/Mission_Z/[/url]

notes.title: Freight Simulator - Tycoon game
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1208950/extras/Main.jpg?t=1598893429[/img]

We recently launched our game called [b]Freight Simulator[/b], a tycoon game where you manage your transport company, buy trucks, locations, accept contracts, deliver freight, invest in the game's stock market and more!

For those who like management games, it is very worth checking out, while you wait for the launch of Mission Z.

[b]See Freight Simulator on Steam:[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1208950/Freight_Simulator/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1208950/Freight_Simulator/[/url]
